Step 1 diagnosis: confirmed via `ls docs/migration/decisions/` that the highest-numbered record is 0019-defer-1c-typed-templates.md -- no 0020 file exists anywhere in the repo. Gathered all 8 citations of decision 0020: REQ-272 and REQ-273 read directly from the already-merged docs/requirements.yaml (more authoritative than GitHub for those two, per the task's own guidance); REQ-274 (gh issue 1095), REQ-275 (1096), REQ-280 (1097), REQ-287 (1098), REQ-288 (1099) and REQ-289 (1100) fetched from GitHub since none of the six has merged yet (confirmed via `git log --oneline main | grep -iE 'REQ-274|REQ-275|REQ-280|REQ-287|REQ-288|REQ-289'` returning no hits, and `grep REQ-274|...` over docs/requirements.yaml returning no files). Full verbatim citation text, plus a per-citation 'asserts' synthesis line, is recorded in docs/issues/ISS-0546.yaml's diagnosis.citations_gathered.

Synthesis (docs/issues/ISS-0546.yaml's diagnosis.synthesis, full text there): the 8 citations are mutually consistent, not contradictory, and specific enough to reconstruct rather than invent. D2/D2a (frontend, cited by REQ-272/274/275/287) = build design-system.md's primitives into web/src/components/ui/, migrate pages separately, explicitly reject adopting a component library. D3/D3a (form-schema, cited by REQ-273 only) = form_schema is a rendering payload not a validation authority, untrusted input requiring JsonSchemaShape.check/1, served at the pinned version per REQ-126. D1/D1a (backend, cited by REQ-280/288/289) = closed tenant-settings vocabulary + canonical tokens.css brand colour (resolving a real, named 3-way #228be6/#2563EB/#0B5FFF inconsistency), CEL-subset expressions validated at definition time via Letflow.Engine.Expr, and a conformance corpus required before any second-language evaluator. A numbered 'Sequencing' section is also evidenced (REQ-280=step4, REQ-288=step8, REQ-289=step9), implying unfilled steps 1-3/5-7 that no gathered citation quotes -- flagged for CODE-DESIGNER to either reconstruct-and-flag or explicitly scope around.
